estimate.damage_summary: A nearby atmospheric discharge caused an overvoltage surge through the building’s electrical installation, physically damaging a speaker system and TV. No surge-protective device was used; a technician later attended to diagnose the surge failure and check wiring safety.
estimate.policy_notes: The damaged appliances are covered under the lightning-overvoltage peril, subject to the EUR 5,000 VAT-inclusive event sub-limit and the standard-grade replacement basis. Because the appliances were connected without surge protection, indemnity for them is halved. Diagnostic reports and contractor business-operation charges are not repair costs; call-out charges are indemnifiable only alongside covered work on the same invoice.

lines.invoice_text: Surge-damaged home electronics (speaker system and TV set)
lines.rationale: The description confirms physical surge damage to both appliances, which are within the covered appliance class; replacement is limited to standard-grade equivalents. With no surge-protective device, the otherwise reasonable amount is subject to the policy’s 50% reduction; the event sub-limit is unlikely to bind for these two items.

lines.invoice_text: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out
lines.rationale: The diagnostic report is the contractor’s own diagnostic/documentation outlay, not a repair cost. The call-out is also not payable here because it accompanies no indemnifiable work on this invoice; one attendance at most would be plausible if the line were otherwise valid.
